description: A single top-level `mappings` array holding every CDC NDC row (one entry per row). Consumers build their own lookups (e.g. by Unit of Sale or Unit of Use NDC11). Each row carries its own cvx_code, since a single NDC can reference multiple CVX codes.

fill_volume_ml.description: Volume in mL that openFDA lists for one unit-of-use container. May include overfill, so it is not the dose volume. Null for kits and non-liquid products.

dose_volume_ml.description: Administered dose volume in mL, from a package-insert override, the CVX description, or a multi-dose vial's per-dose strength. Null when no verified source states it.

doses_per_container.description: Doses in one unit-of-use container, not the sale package: 1 for single-dose containers (single-dose or single-use vials, syringes, ampules, tubes, applicators, and kits of these) and fill volume divided by dose volume for multi-dose vials. Null when unknown, including for vials not labeled single- or multi-dose.

container_type.description: openFDA unit-of-use container type, e.g. "VIAL, MULTI-DOSE", "SYRINGE" or "KIT".

packaging_description.description: openFDA's packaging description for this row's sale NDC. Null when openFDA doesn't list the sale NDC as a package, even if the values above were found through the use NDC.
